Nothing Phone 4b Design Teased Ahead of July 7 India Launch

Tech company Nothing has revealed design elements of its upcoming Phone 4b, scheduled for a July 7 launch in India. The new model is expected to feature dual cameras, a distinctive Glyph Bar, and a blue colorway. This launch marks the debut of Nothing's new 'b' series of smartphones.
